facts.subject: load nut’s wear indicator
facts.value_as_written: when the wear limit is reached
facts.quote: 7.3 Checking the Load Nut’s Wear Indicator The load nut’s wear indicator must be checked every 6 months, and the pair of nuts must be replaced when the wear limit is reached.
facts.why: The text says the indicator 'must be checked every 6 months, and the pair of nuts must be replaced when the wear limit is reached': the wear limit triggers replacement, not a check.
